VOLCANIC ASH EXERCISE VOLCEX26 WILL TAKE PLACE ON 18 NOVEMBER 2026
FROM 08:00 UTC TO 16:00 UTC.
THE EXERCISE WILL SIMULATE A CONTINUOUS ERUPTION OF VESUVIO VOLCANO
(ID 211020, PSN COORDINATES 404917N0142533E ELEV 4202FT/1281M) IN
NAPLES (ITALY), WITH DISPERSION OF CONTAMINATING ASH CLOUDS.
DURING THE EXERCISE A NUMBER OF MESSAGES (VONA, NOTAM, VAA, SIGMET)
WILL BE ISSUED AND WILL START WITH THE WARNING 'EXERCISE VOLCEX26
EXERCISE' AND END WITH A WARNING 'EXERCISE - EXERCISE - EXERCISE'.
UPON RECEIVING THESE MESSAGES, AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL NOT TAKE ANY
ACTION. ALL EXERCISE ACTIONS AND PROCEDURES SHALL NOT AFFECT REAL
LIFE OPERATIONS.
IN THE EVENT OF AN ACTUAL VOLCANIC ERUPTION THE EXERCISE WILL BE
TERMINATED.
